boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented UH Mānoa environments for independent work, group sessions, and outdoor reading between classes.

cards.title: CNS Student Academic Success Center
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Library, room 002K
cards.notes: Set up in the ground-floor center when you need seating, charging outlets, and a focused stop near Hamilton’s collections.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor academic center with seating and charging outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: The CNS Student Academic Success Center is in Hamilton Library room 002K and provides seating and charging outlets.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Located on the ground floor of Hamilton Library; the page identifies it as room 002K.

cards.title: Hamilton Library
cards.subtitle: Maile Way
cards.notes: Use the seating across the library’s floors for solo coursework, then reserve a private room when your group needs a dedicated setup.
cards.short_summary: A multi-floor library setting with seating and reservable private rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton Library has seating on every floor, and private rooms are available for group study sessions and Zoom classes.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Private rooms are available for group study sessions and Zoom classes; reserve a study room through the library.

cards.entity_name: Physical Life Science Building outdoor tables
cards.title: Physical Life Science Building outdoor tables
cards.subtitle: Outside Physical Life Science Building, by Bilger Hall
cards.notes: Take a notebook or meal outside to the rows of tables beside the building for an open-air work session between science classes.
cards.short_summary: Rows of outdoor tables beside the Physical Life Science Building.
cards.evidence_claim: Rows of tables outside the Physical Life Science Building are identified by UH Mānoa as suitable for studying or eating.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Outside the Physical Life Science Building, which the university describes as left of Bilger Hall and connected to Keller Hall.

cards.title: Campus Center downstairs seating
cards.subtitle: Campus Center, near Warrior Recreation Center
cards.notes: Choose the downstairs seating for a centrally located study break, particularly when you want to stay close to campus services.
cards.short_summary: Downstairs seating in the center of campus near Warrior Recreation Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies downstairs seating in Campus Center near the Warrior Recreation Center as a campus study location.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: The university places this downstairs area by the Warrior Recreation Center.

cards.title: Bilger Hall study spaces
cards.subtitle: Bilger Hall, by the Art Building
cards.notes: Work inside Bilger Hall, or shift outdoors near the Physical Life Science Building when you want a change of setting without leaving the area.
cards.short_summary: Indoor and nearby outdoor study options by the Art Building.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies study spaces inside Bilger Hall and outside near the Physical Life Science Building.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Bilger Hall is described as being by the Art Building; the page notes both indoor and nearby outdoor study space.

cards.title: Life Sciences Building seating
cards.subtitle: Life Sciences Building in Henke Hall
cards.notes: Head toward the back of the Life Sciences Building for its available seating when you need an indoor place to read or draft.
cards.short_summary: Indoor seating toward the back of the Life Sciences Building.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies seating toward the back of the Life Sciences Building in Henke Hall for study or breaks.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: The university locates this study seating inside the Life Sciences Building in Henke Hall.

cards.title: Art Building Breezeway
cards.subtitle: Art Building, near Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the shaded breezeway for a short reading block or to organize notes between classes near Campus Center.
cards.short_summary: A shaded breezeway with seating beside the Art Building.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa describes the Art Building Breezeway as having shaded seating for breaks or studying between classes.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Located by Campus Center, according to the university’s study-spaces page.

cards.title: Sakamaki Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Inside Sakamaki Hall, behind Kuykendall
cards.notes: Bring class reading to the courtyard’s shaded seating for an outdoor session inside Sakamaki Hall’s central open space.
cards.short_summary: A shaded courtyard with seating inside Sakamaki Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies Sakamaki Courtyard, behind Kuykendall and inside Sakamaki Hall, as having shade and seating.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Located behind Kuykendall and inside Sakamaki Hall; the university notes shaded seating.

cards.title: Shidler Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Business Administration Building, in front of Towers D and E
cards.notes: Settle into the shaded courtyard seating in front of Towers D and E for outdoor review or a group conversation.
cards.short_summary: Shaded outdoor seating at the Business Administration Building.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies Shidler Courtyard at the Business Administration Building as providing shaded seating for studying.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Located in front of Towers D and E at the Business Administration Building.

cards.title: Ba-Le Courtyard
cards.subtitle: Hemenway Hall, by Sinclair Library
cards.notes: Choose between the courtyard’s indoor and outdoor seating when you need a flexible place to study or pause near Sinclair Library.
cards.short_summary: Flexible indoor and outdoor seating in Hemenway Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: UH Mānoa identifies Ba-Le Courtyard in Hemenway Hall as having indoor and outdoor seating for studying or breaks.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces | University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
cards.access_notes: Located in Hemenway Hall by Sinclair Library; the university notes both indoor and outdoor seating.
